end_state: Windows MT5 FTMO_Bridge_EA consumes signals from the active MT5 watchfile fed directly from ALPHA via a scheduled gcloud pull (no Mac/Google Drive hop for execution).

authoritative_components.scheduled_task: FXG Windows Direct Pull ALPHA MT5 ftmo_demo2

minimal_manual_checks_windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'FXG Windows Direct Pull ALPHA MT5 ftmo_demo2' | Format-List"
notes: This does not modify FTMO_Bridge_EA logic and does not add any execution routes to the Windows sidecar.
If gcloud auth expires, the pull script will fail and write artifacts/windows_direct_pull_last_status.json with error.
